style.title: Style
style.gradientHint: Has a gradient — a solid color or image replaces it
style.hideHint: Hidden on the published page — shown dimmed here so you can restore it

form.title: Form
form.invalidUrl: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://.
form.applyNote: Form changes apply on your next deploy.

testEmail.sentTo: ✓ Test sent to <mono>{to}</mono>. Check inbox + spam folder.

page.title: Page
page.clickHint: Click any element on the page to edit it.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.note: Anonymous pageviews + outbound clicks. No cookies, no IP storage, no consent banner. Applies on next publish.

health.title: Page health
health.issuesToAddress: {count, plural, one {# issue to address.} other {# issues to address.}}

logo.title: Logo
logo.usedAs: Used as favicon, card badge, OG fallback.
logo.uploadHint: PNG / SVG / WebP. Square images render best.
logo.urlHint: Use the full https:// URL of a hosted image.
logo.autoHint: Coral disc with the first letter of “{title}”.
logo.errorSaveFirst: Save the project before uploading a logo.

theme.title: Looks
theme.noDark: No dark mode for this template
theme.generatorHint: Pick a color → a full coherent palette
theme.fromLogoHint: Recolor the page from your logo's colors — readability guaranteed.
theme.fromLogoError: Couldn't read the logo — try re-uploading it.

motion.title: Motion

hint.calm: Gentle fade-in as sections enter view
hint.editorial: Staggered reveals, hero parallax, animated stats
hint.dramatic: Cinematic reveals, stronger parallax, a pinned headline

motion.note: Adds Apple-style scroll choreography on your live page. The page looks identical frozen — it only moves as visitors scroll, and respects reduced-motion settings.

music.title: Music
music.uploadError: Upload failed — try a different file.
music.formats: MP3, M4A, OGG or WAV · up to 12 MB.
music.note: Adds a floating tap-to-play player to your live page, styled to match your theme. Browsers never autoplay sound — visitors tap to listen. Use audio you have the rights to.

tematica.title: World
tematica.note: Wraps your page in a full-page world — backdrop, glass cards, matching palette and type. Composes with Looks and Motion; turn it off anytime.
tematica.uploadError: Upload failed — try a different image.

toast.themeFromLogoError: Couldn't read the logo — try re-uploading it.
toast.worldError: Upload failed — try a different image.

original.title: Original
original.hint: Return the page to how it was born (or your last applied AI redesign).
original.note: Your current version is saved first — you can undo from Versions.
